chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Working for Kid Ory; Barney Bigard got Ory out of the post office
summary: Mingus was hired by Ory after Barney Bigard, who brought Ory back to playing.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. I was going to ask about Orey. Some of the older people from New Orleans used to be very elitist about their music, saying that they knew how to play this better than anybody else. Was he like that?
He hired me. And I didn't know anything about it. I just read what he had to read.
Did he give you any advice or anything like that?
Well, see, I was with Barney Bigard before I went to him, and (inaudible). So I got the footwork with Barney Bigard. He's the one who got Kid Orey out of the post office.
Yeah, Kid Orey was -- it was Barney Bigard that brought him out. He couldn't hardly play his trombone. He hadn't touched it in years.
